chapter: Chords, recordings and his own groups
title: Hip operations; the chord book begins; Purple Manor and Olatunji
summary: About 1968 he started thinking about chords while leading an organ trio at the Purple Manor and playing with Olatunji's African ensemble.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: ... that's part of my book, that I'm writing, that everything is in chords -- no single notes, period...
When did you start thinking about chords and studying?
See, I've been operated on a few times, leg business. I got three pins and I've been operated on about seven times, man. I mean heavy ones...

Around '68 I commenced to thinkin', then I had so much trouble with an organ player. I had an organ trio at the time at a place called the Purple Manor on 125th St. near Madison Avenue, and also at that particular time I was playing with a fella named Olatunji -- big African ensemble... I stayed with Olatunji for quite a while... And playing the African music is not easy, its way off. And I still had to do it by ear... but he liked the way I played. So I played some very important dates with Olatunji. For diplomats and parties and things...
